app-manifest.runtimeRationale: App Manifest v2.x (reframed from Bundle Manifest v1.0 and extended by v2.1 for dataSources[] plus v2.2 for components[]) defines a declarative composition envelope with no business logic; schema validation plus the §6.1 processor rules are sufficient. Loader implementations (Rust crate, TS module, Python loader) are explicitly out of scope per §6.3. As a consequence, §6.1 rule 4 (§5.3 sibling-pin consistency) and rule 6 (§5.4 module coherence) require an online sibling-resolver and are NOT covered by the static fixture corpus; conformance suites that exercise rules 4+6 must stub the sibling-load seam. This row gains crate / package surfaces — and corresponding integration fixtures — once a renderer / Studio / MCP consumer adopts the App Manifest.
